facts.text: The hotel's address is Paseo de Gracia 68-70, 08007 Barcelona.
facts.excerpt: Paseo de Gracia, 68 - 70, 08007, Barcelona, España

facts.text: The hotel is a block away from Gaudí's La Pedrera (Casa Milà).
facts.excerpt: Just a block away from **Gaudí’s world-famous La Pedrera (Casa Milà)** and the iconic Passeig de Gràcia

facts.text: La Dolce Vitae is a restaurant and bar on the hotel's rooftop terrace.
facts.excerpt: La Dolce Vitae is the spectacular terrace located on the roof of the hotel

facts.text: From the rooftop terrace you can see the Sagrada Familia, Casa Batlló and the Glòries Tower.
facts.excerpt: along with its most emblematic architectural icons such as the Sagrada Familia, Casa Batlló and the Glòries Tower

facts.text: On summer nights the rooftop hosts the Majestic Sunset Sessions with a resident DJ and international guest DJs.
facts.excerpt: to the rhythm of the Majestic Sunset Sessions with our resident DJ and other recognized international DJs during the summer nights

facts.text: The hotel has its own farm in the Maresme area, near the Mediterranean, which grows vegetables for Restaurant SOLC.
facts.excerpt: the establishment itself has a farm in the Maresme area (a few kilometres from the restaurant and just a few metres from the Mediterranean Sea)

facts.text: Fish for SOLC comes daily from the Barcelona fish market.
facts.excerpt: The menu is completed by fish brought in daily from the Barcelona fish market

facts.text: Restaurant SOLC is recognized by the Michelin Guide.
facts.excerpt: The Restaurant SOLC, **recognized by the Michelin Guide**, invites you to enjoy a brunch

facts.text: SOLC serves a gourmet brunch every Sunday.
facts.excerpt: A reimagined culinary date to enjoy every Sunday.

facts.text: Chef David Romero devised the SOLC Gourmet Brunch, which follows SOLC's farm-to-table concept.
facts.excerpt: This formula devised by our chef David Romero offers a proposal that follows the "Farm to Table" concept of SOLC Restaurant.

facts.text: The SOLC Gourmet Brunch was recognized in the Best Luxury Hotel Brunch category at the Beyond Luxury Awards 2023.
facts.excerpt: Recognized in the "Best Luxury Hotel Brunch" category at the "Beyond Luxury Awards 2023".

facts.text: A pianist plays in El Bar del Majestic several evenings a week.
facts.excerpt: the pianist who livens up the evenings several days a week

facts.text: The wellness area has a heated pool and a hydromassage pool.
facts.excerpt: Our exclusive space features a 12-meter heated pool and a 20m² hydromassage pool

facts.text: The spa is on the highest floor of the building.
facts.excerpt: Located on the highest floor of the building, an excellent team of professionals

facts.text: A Rossano Ferretti HairSpa had its grand opening at the hotel on 9 October 2026.
facts.excerpt: Grand Opening: Friday, Octuber 9th, 2026

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has a private terrace with solarium and panoramic views over Paseo de Gracia or the Sagrada Familia.
facts.excerpt: with a private terrace with solarium and panoramic views overlooking Paseo de Gracia or La Sagrada Familia

facts.text: The hotel's apartments are at 69 Passeig de Gràcia, across from the hotel in a separate building.
facts.excerpt: Located at 69 de Passeig de Gràcia, in front of the hotel, but in an independent building.

facts.text: The Duplex Passeig de Gràcia apartment is a two-storey flat with a terrace and views over La Pedrera, the Sagrada Familia and Paseo de Gracia.
facts.excerpt: two-storey flat with terrace and views over La Pedrera, Sagrada Familia and Paseo de Gracia

facts.text: Privilege Family rooms sleep up to 3 adults or 2 adults and 2 children under 12, with a king bed and a sofa bed.
facts.excerpt: capacity for up to 3 adults or 2 adults and 2 children (under 12 years old), king size bed and sofa-bed

facts.text: An adapted room is available for guests with reduced mobility.
facts.excerpt: Perfectly adapted to accommodate guests with reduced mobility.

facts.text: The Majestic is over 100 years old.
facts.excerpt: The Majestic is over 100 years old

facts.text: Bathroom products are by Atelier Cologne, which also created the hotel's own scent, Musc Impérial.
facts.excerpt: The bathroom products are by the prestigious French Atelier Cologne, which has also developed the hotel’s bespoke scent, Musc Impérial.

facts.text: The Royal Penthouse includes a driver, luxury car, private butler and a private rooftop terrace with an outdoor jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: includes access to exclusive services like a driver, luxury car and private butler, as well as a sprawling private rooftop terrace with an outdoor jacuzzi

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2018, 2019, 2025 and 2026.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2018, 2019, 2025, 2026

facts.text: The rooms have very high ceilings and an understated cream and beige colour scheme.
facts.excerpt: The color scheme is understated (muted creams and beiges) and the ceilings are very high.

facts.text: On summer weekends the rooftop crowd is younger, with top DJs spinning under the stars.
facts.excerpt: On summer weekends, you’ll discover that the crowd on the roof is younger and hipper than elsewhere in the hotel, as the Majestic mixes things up with top DJs spinning under the stars.

facts.text: CNT calls the Royal Penthouse the largest suite in the city.
facts.excerpt: The Majestic Royal Penthouse is the largest suite in the city
